about_the_game:
One town. One curse. Endless horror.

The town of Ashfall is dying—but not by the same hand. Each time you return, a new horror rules over it, chosen at random. In Soul Scar, your mission is never simple, and never the same.

Craft a party of four heroes from nine tormented classes—Priests, wizards, rogues, and more. Name them. Shape them. Watch them suffer. Then guide them through the shadows of Ashfall, where survivors cling to hope and whispers of salvation hide behind every locked door.

Ashfall is your hub—your only refuge. Rest, recover, accept quests... but know this: time is short. The evil that grips the town grows stronger with each passing moment. Venture beyond its walls to explore haunted woods, sunken crypts, forgotten sanctuaries—each filled with randomized treasures, deadly encounters, and scars that never fade.

Your journey ends only when you face the boss... whoever—or whatever—it may be. Every run reshapes the threat. Every defeat leaves its mark. And every victory unlocks New Game+, letting you retain your party and gear as the darkness deepens.

Nine unique classes – Combine brute strength, arcane magic, or forbidden arts

Party-based strategy – Build and name your team of four; synergy is survival

Randomized final boss – Face a new evil each run for endless replayability

Ashfall quests & lore – Discover the town’s secrets through optional missions

Mystic treasure system – Loot and gear are randomized each playthrough

New Game+ – Keep your characters and items as the nightmare escalates

Veteran Experience – Improve your attributes and learn deadly skills

short_description: Evil waits behind a random mask. Choose your party of four and travel to Ashfall- a cursed town doomed to relive its suffering. Uncover its secrets, hunt the hidden boss, and forge your legacy through blood and ash.
